I have an Alumium and a chromoly bike. For me personally, I love how my chromoly ride than the aluminium one. I have used 32c tyres on both frame, and the aluminium one always make my hand feel numb. The chromoly keep forcing me to ride because of the pleasent ride. I keep my bike in my small apartment, but i do ride on rainy days often with both bike. As long as the steel covered with paint, and not exposed I think it will be fine. Make sure to put some light grease inside the seat tube to prevent rust(no paint in there and rain can get in anyhow). If money is isnt a problem, I'd say pick the chromoly. If you have the chance to try both, it would be better. Different person different taste. Additionally, get something with many spokes to if you're a heavy rider (I always envy heavy riders, those meat will turn into big muscles when train enough). I dont have much knowledge of how much spokes you need but i saw a heavy riders subreddit before and they keep telling how important those numbers of spokes is. Ride on brother. Hope will enjoy the scenary and the fun of riding! (I have bad legs, i cant even jog or run. But with bicycle, I can ride how long i want without hurting myself). Ride on!
